title: Test scaffold
description: Add a tests/ directory with pytest configured (pytest.ini or requirements-dev.txt) and at least one real test covering an existing pure helper in dossier/ (e.g. momentum-scoring or a parsing function). This unblocks a 'run tests first' validation step for every subsequent feature.
notes: Added tests/ with pytest.ini and requirements-dev.txt. 38 tests cover _parse_market_cap, _parse_vol_string, check_quality (quality_filter.py), _clamp, and score_momentum (momentum_picks.py). All pass in 0.07s.

title: Input validation on external API responses
description: In the dossier data-fetch stage, add defensive checks for known failure shapes: empty payloads, Tradier's 'null' string, and missing yfinance keys. A bad upstream response should fail loudly with a clear message instead of silently corrupting downstream data.
notes: Added dossier/utils/validate_api.py with check_yfinance_history (validates required columns + min rows), check_yfinance_info (warns on empty fundamentals), is_tradier_null (Tradier "null" string + None + empty collection), and safe_json (guards JSON decode). Applied in ticker_enrichment.py, market_pulse.py, ghost_alpha_screener.py, and gamma_pin_screener.py. 33 new tests, all 71 pass.

title: Substack engagement resilience
description: In substack_social/, wrap network calls with bounded retries and clear logging so a transient failure does not abort the entire engage/pulse run. The vendored fork in vendor/ must not be modified.
notes: Added substack_social/retry.ts with withRetry<T>(fn, label, attempts=3) — exponential back-off (1s, 2s, 4s), warn on each retry attempt, error log on final failure, re-throws so callers keep existing try/catch behaviour. Applied in engage.ts: ownProfile(), post.like(), note.like(), post.fullPost(). Applied in ticker_pulse.ts: profileForSlug(), post.fullPost(). Vendor fork untouched. Python tests: 71/71 passed.

title: Wire auto_backtest.py into the daily pipeline
description: Add auto_backtest.py as a late, guarded stage of the dossier run so backtest results are generated daily. A backtest failure must not fail the whole pipeline — log the error and continue.
notes: The pipeline call already existed in generate.py (stage 15d inside `if not dry_run:`). Added timer.stage('Auto-Backtest') so the stage appears in the status dashboard with timing and error info. Fixed a dead-code bug in recalculate_stats (bogus ternary key for worst_pick that was immediately overwritten). Added tests/test_auto_backtest.py with 9 tests covering load_track_record, save_track_record, and recalculate_stats. All 80 tests pass.

title: Market mood ring — persist regime history + dossier header banner
description: The pipeline already computes a daily market regime (dossier/market_regime.py detect_regime() returns vix_level, regime_name, and regime) but only prints it and overwrites a single snapshot into landing/data/pipeline_stats.json. Add a persistent, append-only time series and a visual 'mood ring' on top of that EXISTING signal — do not add or change any regime/signal math. (1) In generate.py, after the Market Regime stage, append today's regime to a deduped, date-keyed history file (e.g. landing/data/regime_history.json): {date, regime, regime_name, vix_level, spy_change}; re-running for the same date must overwrite that day's entry, not duplicate it. Guard it so a write failure logs a warning and never fails the pipeline. (2) Map each regime to a mood color + emoji (risk-on/green, neutral/amber, risk-off/red) in a small pure helper, and render a colored mood-ring banner on the dossier HTML header showing today's mood plus a strip of the last ~10 days' emojis from the history. (3) Add tests for the history append/dedup logic and the regime→mood mapping. Validate by running the dossier stage (or a dry run) and confirming regime_history.json is appended and the banner renders.
notes: Added dossier/mood_ring.py (pure helpers: regime_to_mood, load_history, append_regime/record_regime with date-dedup, build_mood_ring). Wired into generate.py as guarded Stage 4a — appends {date, regime, regime_name, vix_level, spy_change} to landing/data/regime_history.json, never fails the pipeline. builder.py loads the history and passes mood_ring context; template.html renders a colored mood banner + last-10-days emoji strip in the header. Colors match the 3-color HUD (green/amber/red). BONUS (per Michael's 'something for the grandmas' ask): added dossier/grandma_mode.py + a tap-to-translate Grandma Mode panel that turns the day into plain English with a jargon glossary. 52 new tests (test_mood_ring.py + test_grandma_mode.py); full suite 132 passed.
